#!/bin/sh
# Nightly log backup. Bundles logs/ into a dated tarball and copies it off-host.
set -eu

DEST='backup-srv:/srv/nightly'
STAMP=$(date +%Y%m%d)
SCRIPT_DIR=$(CDPATH= cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)
BUNDLE="$SCRIPT_DIR/logs-$STAMP.tar.gz"

# Use the script's directory so cron can run this job from any working directory.
tar -C "$SCRIPT_DIR" -czf "$BUNDLE" logs/
scp "$BUNDLE" "$DEST/"
echo "wrote and copied $BUNDLE to $DEST/"

arguments.command:
set -eu
sh -n backup.sh
repo=$(pwd)
tmp=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"; rm -f "$repo/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"' EXIT
cat > "$tmp/scp" <<'EOF'
#!/bin/sh
printf '%s\n' "$@" > "$SCP_ARGS_FILE"
EOF
chmod +x "$tmp/scp"
export SCP_ARGS_FILE="$tmp/scp-args"
(
  cd /tmp
  PATH="$tmp:$PATH" "$repo/backup.sh"
)
bundle="$repo/logs-$(date +%Y%m%d).tar.gz"
tar -tzf "$bundle"
printf '%s\n' '--- scp arguments ---'
cat "$tmp/scp-args"
